flag.reason: GRPR targeting is selected by imaging uptake of the paired tracer rather than a molecular assay; manual section 5 says imaging-only markers are not molecular biomarkers, but the trial title and criteria require GRPR-expressing tumours.

coder_notes: Multi-tumour basket (prostate, breast, colorectal, cervical, NSCLC, recurrent GBM in MAD Q4W cohorts). The diagnostic 203Pb tracer is not a registered intervention but is given to determine eligibility (uptake required) and has its own safety outcome, so it is listed as a diagnostic_agent row with no arm. Dosimetry sub-study is mentioned but PK sample types are stated as whole blood, plasma and urine only, so tumour PK is coded no. Whether GRPR-uptake imaging counts as a molecular biomarker for the primary outcome (candidate_matched_selection) needs adjudication.
